controller.title: Controller relays
controller.description:
Controller type: {controller_type}

Relay 1: delay {delay_1} s
Relay 2: delay {delay_2} s
Relay 3: delay {delay_3} s

A delay of 0 s means the relay latches until switched off; otherwise it switches off by itself after the delay. Delays are set in the intercom's web interface.

Choose which relays to add to Home Assistant. You can change this later with Configure.
